title: herdr-desk repo config
description: Usually { name }. Defaults: playbook github-issues, job id desk:github-issues, schedule 0 7 * * *, 5 worktrees, <name>-desk, agent grok. extra is inline markdown or a .md path.

group.description: Marks an umbrella config that applies to every repo beneath this directory.

playbook.description: Bundled id (github-issues), a .md path, or inline markdown.

extra.description: Repo addendum. Inline markdown, or a path if that file exists.

kind.description: Deprecated: use agent. Read as a one-rung agent ladder.

autoUpdate.description: Machine config.json only; ignored in repo files. When true, the daemon applies a newer GitHub release (checked at most once a day) by reinstalling the plugin.

notify.description: Where this desk's notices go. Destination only: the bot token is a host secret and belongs in notify.json, never in a committed repo config.

enabled.description: Only ever narrows. A layer cannot re-enable what a higher-priority layer turned off.

schedule.description: When to run. One cron, or several crons that all run this playbook.

rung.description: One rung of the agent ladder. A bare Herdr kind (claude, codex, opencode, …) or a command (anyr claude --yolo, opencode2, ./scripts/desk-agent.sh).

agent.description: Which local coding agent runs this job. A bare rung, or a block. The ladder is tried in order; a failure escalates down it.

permission.description: Permission posture, e.g. default or yolo.

timeoutMs.description: Readiness budget for one launch attempt.

id.description: Job handle. desk: for a bundled playbook, local: for a repo-owned prompt.

playbook.description: Bundled id (github-issues), a .md path, or inline markdown.

tasks.extra: Children never deploy. Manager deploys from main.
